# VoiceDebrief for iPhone and iPad

> A native iPhone and iPad app, in development, that turns a voice note into a transcript and a
> short debrief using Apple's on-device models only (SpeechAnalyzer and the Foundation Models
> framework): no OpenRouter, no API key, no inference server. Results are kept in an sgit vault
> the user owns, opened with a passkey as pki.sgit.ai does it, and signed with the user's own key
> bundle (RSA-OAEP 4096 and ECDSA P-256). STATUS: a test build (TestFlight, not public) records
> or opens a voice note, transcribes it and writes a debrief on the device; nobody has judged the
> results yet. It keeps notes on the device and can save one to a vault. The account, sync between
> devices and the identity are NOT built.

Part of VoiceDebrief (https://voicedebrief.ai). Content CC BY 4.0; code Apache 2.0.
Every page has a markdown twin: replace index.html with index.md.

## Start here

- https://ios.app.voicedebrief.ai/built/index.html : the reality file. What exists, how it is
  tested, what does not exist. If it is not listed there as built, it does not exist.
- https://ios.app.voicedebrief.ai/architecture/index.html : how it works, in four drawings (SVG under
  /assets/diagrams/): the parts, the life of a recording, the keys, two devices. Each element is marked
  seen working, unconfirmed, or decided and not built. Explains; the reality file certifies.
- https://ios.app.voicedebrief.ai/conductors/index.html : FOR AN AGENT OR PERSON WHO WANTS TO RECEIVE NOTES. How
  to make an inbox with tools/conductor/conductor.py, hand out its QR code or link, and open what arrives.
- https://ios.app.voicedebrief.ai/credit/index.html : credit. IN TEST, NO MONEY CHANGES HANDS: a ledger on the device in
  micro-credits (a millionth of a pound), placeholder prices, a balance that may go below zero with nothing
  blocked, a simulated top-up. What Apple requires for a real one (in-app purchase, sandbox in TestFlight), what
  the owner must create, and why nothing stops someone editing their own balance.
- https://ios.app.voicedebrief.ai/plan/index.html : the implementation plan. Mostly PROPOSED:
  the pipeline on Apple's models, the passkey account (door, master, debriefs vault), the vault
  layout, the identity, the repository and CI, milestones, risks, and what was decided since.
- https://ios.app.voicedebrief.ai/design/index.html : the agreed design. Intention, not fact: the
  three jobs (capture without loss first), the decisions, the screens, three builds, open questions.
- https://ios.app.voicedebrief.ai/develop/index.html : repository layout, what CI does (it is
  the compiler: Swift is not built on Linux), how the site is built, how a release is made.
  Also how CI photographs every screen from invented sample data (screens.yml), and how an agent
  in a Linux container downloads and looks at the pictures.
- https://ios.app.voicedebrief.ai/versions/index.html : release history.
- https://ios.app.voicedebrief.ai/index.html : the home page.

## The sgit app (a second app in this repository, for now)

- https://ios.app.voicedebrief.ai/sgit-app/design/index.html : sgit as a native app for iPhone, iPad and
  Mac. Intention: put photos, videos and large files in a vault, browse, share, history; the share
  mechanisms that exist; the limits. It will move to its own repository and site.
- https://ios.app.voicedebrief.ai/sgit-app/built/index.html : its reality file. If it is not listed
  there as built, it does not exist.

## Articles (ideas, positions and briefs; intention, not fact)

- https://ios.app.voicedebrief.ai/articles/index.html : the list.
- https://ios.app.voicedebrief.ai/articles/the-lab/index.html : the app as a laboratory; experiments L01 to L10.
- https://ios.app.voicedebrief.ai/articles/two-decision-engines/index.html : the code owns the states; the
  model is asked one question at a time through function calls, with no long history.
- https://ios.app.voicedebrief.ai/articles/a-harness-inside-the-app/index.html : the doors of SHarness (network,
  files, vault, keys, model, run) inside the app, and drawing what passes through them.
- https://ios.app.voicedebrief.ai/articles/the-vault-is-a-version-controlled-store/index.html : vaults are
  local first and need no token; a server is a remote; several vaults and lanes; vault apps; graphs.
- https://ios.app.voicedebrief.ai/articles/where-each-key-lives/index.html : DECIDED by the owner: vault keys
  sync through iCloud Keychain, on by default; a user key pair that travels; a device key that never does; the
  user vouches for the device; optionally a delegation from pki.sgit.ai.
- https://ios.app.voicedebrief.ai/articles/voice-everywhere/index.html : never lose a recording; voice from
  every screen.
- https://ios.app.voicedebrief.ai/articles/a-private-voice-note-and-a-clinic/index.html : the workflow between a
  patient and a clinician, with a drawing; what is built, what was overstated, what data protection still asks.
- https://ios.app.voicedebrief.ai/articles/synthetic-users/index.html : invented users walking screenshots.

## Facts worth knowing before you work on it

- Source: https://github.com/VoiceDebrief/VoiceDebrief__App__iOS (default branch dev, which
  publishes this site).
- The vault engine is Packages/SGitVault, copied from PrompTugal__App__iOS; its origin and the
  changes made here are in Packages/SGitVault/SOURCE.md.
- Vault format, key derivation and the passkey door are sgit's: https://sgit.ai/security/index.html
  and https://pki.sgit.ai/llms.txt
- No vault key, access key, API key or private key is ever committed. The fixture vaults under
  Packages/SGitVault/Tests/ are throwaway and exist on no server.
